title: What does NFTokenCancelOffer do on XRPL?
abstract: Sourced explanation of NFTokenCancelOffer and its practical limits.
body:
According to XRPL documentation, NFTokenCancelOffer removes specified outstanding NFT offers without transferring the NFT. [1]

The transaction takes offer identifiers and applies the reference's cancellation permissions, including expiration-related rules. Canceling a buy offer and canceling a sell offer remove different trading commitments. Inspect the validated result for the intended offers. An expired or canceled listing is not a completed sale and should not generate a purchase receipt. [1]

The NFTokenCancelOffer reference defines the operation-specific fields alongside the shared XRPL transaction fields. Account identifies the submitting account; signing authority, transaction cost and sequence handling still have to satisfy the ledger rules. A submitted transaction or an example in documentation does not establish a successful validated result. Where an amendment is required, confirm it is enabled on the intended network before relying on the feature. [1][2]

Author interpretation: before using NFTokenCancelOffer, compare the intended change with the current ledger state and keep the transaction hash with the resulting metadata. Treat unresolved outcomes as unresolved; submitting a replacement operation can create a second obligation. These are integration recommendations, not a report of a live test. Sources accessed 10 November 2026.
